## 8afacf592980

Concrete override-contract failure: `palette_kind="warm"` is inert.

Replay with difficulty `easy`, seed `0`, sample index `0`. The unoverridden input and the `palette_kind="warm"` input are byte-identical. The generated colors are `{3,5}` even though the declared warm palette is `{2,3,4,6,7,9}`; color `5` appears three times. The authority output is `[[5,5,5,5,5]]`.

This matters beyond metadata honesty: an override/coverage gate can report the warm branch as requested while training data remains on the same default palette branch. Full replay data and grids are retained in `checks/audit-8af-axis.json`.

A separate shortcut risk is visible in the canonical set: each canonical input uses only one nonzero color, so “repeat the sole nonzero color by its count” fits those examples. Ordinary generated multi-color cases can refute it, but the inert palette override weakens confidence that requested color regimes are actually exercised.
